parameters.help_en: The video resolution. Valid values: 1080P, 720P, and 480P. Default value: 1080P
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio of the video. Valid values: adaptive, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, and 9:16. Default value: adaptive
parameters.name: ratio

parameters.help_en: The duration of the video in seconds. Valid values: an integer from 2 to 30, -1 for intelligent duration, and 0 for the server default of 5 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 视频时长（秒）：[2,30] 或 -1（智能时长）；0 = 服务端默认 5 秒
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include an audio track. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含音轨，默认 true
parameters.name: audio

parameters.help_en: The random seed. Valid values: -1 (random) or an integer from 0 to 2147483647. A value of 0 is a valid reproducible seed. If not specified, the server uses a random seed by default
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent prompt rewriting. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启智能改写（prompt_extend），默认 true
parameters.name: prompt_extend

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add a Model Studio watermark. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否添加百炼水印，默认 false
parameters.name: watermark

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The additional information. A value of success is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
